notes.title: Play the new version of Devil Dead ! Join the beta participation !
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Owners and players of the former Devils'n Dragons, you were promised a big new version of the game in october 2024, but unfortunately, I'm not ready to publish this major update.

This update is not abandoned, but it will take longer than expected. it is delayed to the 1st trimester 2025, all my apologies for this delay...

But I give you access to the developpement version of Devil Dead: join the "beta_participation" accessible in your library !

Goto 100 Studio

notes.title: Look at the new Devil Dead Version in the Demo Version of the Game !
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

The new version of the game ("Devil Dead") promised for October 24 is not ready, it is postponed to the beginning of 2025... My apologies for the delay.

Sorry for the delay, but I prefer to take time for development than make a sloppy version.

However, the demo version of the game has just been released! It contains stage 01 of the world "Cemetery Hill". Feel free to try it and leave your feedback in the forum, it will help me a lot.

I’m alone to develop the game and it takes a lot of time to develop, even an indie game!

I uploaded the new version of the game on steam by mistake, you understand it, it is the unfinished version. It contains the first world (the 3 stages of the cemetery hill, the final boss, the passage to the world of the haunted forest, and the first 2 stages of the world of the haunted forest. If you update the game, you will no longer be able to play the original version of the game you purchased ("Devils'n Dragons). If you buy the game now ("Devil Dead") you will not get the finished version of the game. If this poses a problem I will switch back to the old build of the game "Devils'n Dragons".

Of course, the final version of the game "Devil’s Dead" will be free for those who already purchased "Devils'n Dragons"

Thank you for reading to me

Philippe de Goto 100 Studio

notes.title: Patch 2023-12-01 : adjust gamepad sensitivity + saving settings
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

You can now adjust the sensitivity of the gamepad axis and the gamepad buttons threshold.

You can save and restore the settings of the game :

[list]
[*] video mode
[*] sounds and music level
[*] gamepad sensitivity
[/list]

the saved settings are automatically restore at the launch

notes.title: Patch 2023-04-01 : Fix Crash, crash at Launch, Freezing Issues.
notes.notes:
Fix Crash, crash at Launch, Freezing Issues, and significantly reduces loading time.

(A bad texture's management caused Fps drops or worse some game crashing, especialy on small configs)

This patch should fix the problem.

Nevertheless, some sprites may appear uggly (squared) at the start of the game, but that will disappear by itself very quickly. (will be fixed in the next update)

My apologies for the bad gameplay experience.
